title: Durable send planner requires W21 source custody

conditions.description: At accepted abef95dc790ce6f95c51968e8cfb37203c431887, Client/Modules/ProjectCapacityAdmission.fs:28-56 keeps the actual state path, validating reader and change serializer private; :102-123 places the only Held-to-Dispatching transition and beginSend inside PROJECT_CAPACITY_DISPOSABLE_TEST_ONLY. Its exact original, owner, role/version, generation and Held checks live at :109-116. LedgerStore.fs:2829-2853 permits real CAS composition and bypasses the planner on same-operation replay; :2909-2944 reconciles publication. A new W16-only file cannot invoke the private validated reader/change or test-only transition in a normal build. Reimplementing those functions would duplicate W21's state machine/validation and violate the task's reuse constraint; turning on the test flag would also expose fixture initialization/exclusion and invent production authority. Please coordinate W21 custody or a narrow lease for extraction of a default-off internal Held-to-Dispatching planner using the existing validated read/change and identity checks, separately from fixture initializer/exclusion, with explicit replay-is-not-send semantics. Then W16 can build a new-file transaction adapter and isolated tests on the exact reviewed source, or Lead can assign the minimal shared change to W21. Baseline and terminal issuer remain unavailable; no live effects or cutover.
